LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.BindingNote: Mice do not report their side buttons. If Mouse 4 does nothing, use the middle mouse button or bind a key. Middle mouse also drags the camera while held.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.KeyIsPinModifier: {0} is also the key you hold to pin, so pinning will open the menu. Pick another key or another pin key.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.Title: Quick Menu
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.PageError: The Quick Menu settings page could not be drawn. See the log for details.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.PinWithSuffix: + click on a build or order
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.MintActive: Dubs Mint Menus is active, so Alt is used and Ctrl+click stays with Mint.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.ClearAllPinsConfirm: Remove every pin from the quick menu? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.SizeFixedTip: The menu always has the rings, or the columns and rows, set here. Empty slots are drawn, and a pin keeps its place.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.SizeAutoTip: The menu grows with your pins: one ring or row more when the last is full, up to what fits the screen.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.PreviewTooBig: At this UI scale the menu is bigger than the screen and will be centred.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.PreviewHidden: {0} pins are outside the menu and stay hidden until you make it bigger again.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.MissingPins: {0} pins are from mods that are not loaded. They come back when the mods are added back.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.MissingUnknown: Pins from mods that are not loaded can be checked once the game has finished loading its build menu.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.ForgetMissingConfirm: Remove the pins from mods that are not loaded? They will not come back when you add the mods again.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Settings.ResetDefaultsTip: Restores every option above to its default. Your pins are kept.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Capture.Title: Set the menu button
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Capture.Body: Press a key or a middle or side mouse button.\nEsc cancels.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Capture.Rejected: Left and right click can't open the menu.
